title: Analysis, thermodynamics, and a numerical solver for a pressure-temperature equilibrium closure of the four-equation model
summary: We analyze an often used closure model for multi-material hydrodynamics where pressure-temperature equilibrium (PTE) is assumed for every state; emphasis is placed on tabular equations of state. This multi-material model is often referred to as the four-equation model. The identification of the admissible set is presented and is proven to be convex, setting the foundation for development of invariant-domain preserving methods for this model.
